body.statement: For absolute constants \(0<c<C<\infty\), if \(K\ge d^2\) then \(c\min\{1,dK\log(eK)/n\}\le R(n,d,K)\le C\min\{1,dK\log(eK)/n\}\).
body.justification: This is the first genuinely joint solved region and a non-negotiable splice for the full frontier.
body.gap: No named published result gives minimax MSE for grouped causal optimal value in a jointly growing \(d,K\) region.
body.consumer: Menu-expansion studies can read off the sample size required once the number of treatments dominates the square of patient-group count.
